This installment promises to deliver the same addictive gameplay that captured the hearts of players worldwide. Your ultimate goal is to reach the red flag at the end of each level, but getting there won't be easy. You'll need to avoid deadly enemies, navigate treacherous terrain, and collect precious oranges to boost your score.

With eight levels to play, Haton 2 offers a generous helping of content that's sure to keep you entertained for hours on end.
